$comment: Single source of truth for the secret-bearing key names the free-text log redactors mask (#4430). Read by src/utils/redactLogText.ts and core/src/diagnostics/redact.rs, which both build their key pattern from it with the same algorithm (see secretKeyPattern / secret_key_pattern) and are pinned by the shared vectors in src/test/fixtures/redaction/secret-text-vectors.json. A key matches when one of these terms is its whole name or its last component: after a '_' or '-' separator in any case (ssh_password, X-Auth-Token, MY_API_KEY), at a camelCase boundary (sshPassword, keyPassphrase, clientSecret) or glued to one of gluedPrefixes in any case (sshpassword, accesstoken). A trailing plural 's' is always allowed. Only add words here; never remove one.
